user.title: Connect your Dreame account
user.description: Log in with your Dreame (or MOVA) app account. If you normally sign in via 'Sign in with Google' or another third-party login, that won't work here — open the app's profile/security settings first and set a password for your account, then use that email + password below.

device.title: Select your device
device.description: Multiple handheld devices were found on this account.

error.login_error: Could not log in. Check your email/password and region — or, if you use Google/third-party sign-in, set a password for your account in the app first.
error.no_devices: No handheld (H-series) devices were found on this account.
